page.title: Kɔnɛkta dɛn
page.intro: Kɔnekt yu advatayzmɛnt akɔn dɛn. Lid dɛn frɔm yu advays dɛn kin kam na Mi Lid dɛn ɔtomɛtik wan, wit spɛnd ɛn kɔst fɔ ɛni lid.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form de lid insay Mi Lid, ɛvride spɛn ɛn kɔst fɔ ɛni lid, ɛn lida kwaliti we dɛn sɛn bak to LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: Nɔ sɛt ap pan dis sava yet

banner.connected: LinkedIn dɔn kɔnɛkt. Dɛn de kam wit lida dɛn naw - dis pej de ɔpdet insay wan mɔnt.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn nɔ dɔn sɛt ap pan dis sava yet. Wan administreta fɔ ad di LinkedIn ap in klaynt ID ɛn sikrit.
banner.expired: Di LinkedIn kɔnɛkshɔn dɔn dɔn, so di lida dɛn nɔ de sink. Rikonekt fɔ kɔntinyu.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn nid fɔ mek yu sayn insay bak bay {{date}} . Rikonekt bifo dat fɔ mek di lid dɛn kɔntinyu fɔ flɔ.

connect.title: Kɔnekt LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sayn in wit di LinkedIn akɔn we de manej yu advays dɛn. Leadrat jɔs rid yu ad akɔn dɛn, Lead Gen Form lida dɛn ɛn ad statystik dɛn, ɛn sɛn kɔnvɛnshɔn dɛn we yu swich pan.
connect.need1: Wan rol na di LinkedIn ad akɔn (Viewer ɔ ay pas dat).
connect.need2: Wan rol na di linked kɔmni pej (Administreta, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Kyurɛta ɔ Analyst) - LinkedIn nid am fɔ sheb lida dɛn.
connect.need3: Wan fon nɔmba kwɛshɔn na yu Lead Gen Forms - lida dɛn we nɔ gɛt fon nɔmba nɔ go ebul fɔ ad.

connection.confirmDisconnect: Diskonekt LinkedIn ? Sink de stɔp ɛn di akses token dɛn de dilit. Dɛn kin kip di lida dɛn, di statystik dɛn ɛn di aktiviti lɔg.
connection.noPermission: Yu kin si dis pej. Fɔ kɔnɛkt ɛn chenj di sɛtin dɛn nid di "Manage Settings" pɔmishɔn.
connection.fetchTitle: Fetch lida dɛn bay di deti rɛnj
connection.fetchHint: Dɛn kin chɛk nyu lida dɛn ɛvri sɔm minit ɛn dɛn kin chɛk di las 7 dez bak ɛvride, so dɛn nɔ kin mis natin. Yuz dis fɔ lida dɛn frɔm bifo yu kɔnɛkt, ɔ fɔ chɛk wan tɛm bak (te to 90 dez wan tɛm). Dɛn kin skip di lid dɛn we dɔn ɔlrɛdi de na Leadrat .

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Tɛl LinkedIn uswan pan in lida dɛn bi rial prɔspɛkt. We wan LinkedIn lida rich wan stetɔs we yu pik dɔŋ ya, Leadrat kin ripɔt am to LinkedIn , so yu kampen ripɔt dɛn sho lida kwaliti ɛn LinkedIn kin fɛn mɔ pipul dɛn lɛk yu bɛst lida dɛn. Na di LinkedIn lida ID ɛn wan-way hash fɔ di imel nɔmɔ dɛn kin sɛn.
